description.en: Animates the intensity of an already-active out-of-focus blur ("boke") effect (see CMND_BOKE_CREATE) to a new value over a number of frames, without turning it fully on/off. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.

example.code:
// Change the active blur effect's intensity
CMND_BOKE_FADE(0.5, 15.0);
